verdict.rationale: Glama's docs explicitly describe per-tool access control (enable/disable individual tools) and a gateway that access-controls and logs every call, which directly supports the story. However, there's no evidence of allowlisting specific servers per-agent or granular role-based policies beyond simple enable/disable toggles, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of this control in practice. Missing for 10: evidence of server-level allowlists per agent/identity, role-based or policy-driven access rules, and independent verification of access control enforcement.
